#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a 'Team Meeting' calendar event for next Wednesday at 3 PM (1 hour)."""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import uuid

# Determine the local timezone
now = datetime.now().astimezone()
tz = now.tzinfo
tz_name = getattr(tz, "key", None) or str(tz)

# Compute next Wednesday (weekday() == 2 for Wednesday; Monday == 0)
today = now.date()
days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:  # today is Wednesday -> use the following week
    days_ahead = 7
meeting_date = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

start_dt = datetime(meeting_date.year, meeting_date.month, meeting_date.day, 15, 0, 0, tzinfo=tz)
end_dt = start_dt + timedelta(hours=1)

dtstamp = datetime.now(ZoneInfo("UTC"))
uid = f"team-meeting-{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar.skill"

ics = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{dtstamp.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}
DTSTART;TZID={tz_name}:{start_dt.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}
DTEND;TZID={tz_name}:{end_dt.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}
SUMMARY:Team Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Team meeting scheduled for one hour.
STATUS:CONFIRMED
SEQUENCE:0
TRANSP:OPAQUE
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Team Meeting starts in 15 minutes
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

with open("team_meeting.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\r\n") as f:
    f.write(ics)

# Validation output
print(f"Today: {today} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Meeting date: {meeting_date} ({meeting_date.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Timezone: {tz_name}")
print(f"Start: {start_dt.isoformat()}")
print(f"End: {end_dt.isoformat()}")
print(f"Duration: 1 hour")
print(f"UID: {uid}")
print("---ICS CONTENT---")
print(ics)

end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=1)

# Store the event in UTC so it is unambiguous for any calendar application
start_utc = start_local.astimezone(ZoneInfo("UTC"))
end_utc = end_local.astimezone(ZoneInfo("UTC"))

VERSION:2.0

# Validation output
print(f"Today (local): {today} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Meeting date (local): {meeting_date} ({meeting_date.strftime('%A')})")
